stories.headline: Malinin sets a figure skating world record in Tokyo
stories.summary: Ilia Malinin of the United States has set a world record in the men's short programme at the NHK Trophy in Tokyo, Japan. He scored 114.81 points on the opening day of the competition, which runs from 27 to 29 November. The previous record of 113.97 points had been held since the 2022 Winter Olympics by his compatriot Nathan Chen.

stories.headline: New Zealand's final count leaves its coalition short of a majority
stories.summary: The counting of special votes in New Zealand's general election has cost the National Party two electorate seats. The National-ACT-New Zealand First coalition government now holds 65 of the 130 seats and has fallen below a majority, leaving a hung parliament. The Opportunity Party, which won seven seats and entered Parliament for the first time, is in a kingmaker position.

stories.headline: The narwhal's spiral tusk holds two opposite twists
stories.summary: The male narwhal grows a corkscrew-shaped tooth, unlike the curved tusks of elephants and walruses. It is the upper left canine, which grows forward through the upper lip, twisting anticlockwise, and can reach two metres, as much as half the animal's body length. Researchers have found that its tiny structural components form two intertwined helices that twist in opposite directions.
